verdict.rationale: Poke documents a public API at /docs/api for sending messages programmatically from applications, scripts, and automation tools, and for triggering Poke from services like GitHub, CI/CD, and monitoring tools. Because Poke is conversational, this gives a real programmatic entry point to drive it, but the documented scope appears limited to inbound message sending, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented endpoint/auth reference, ability to read responses or manage state (integrations, reminders, recipes) via API, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
